about_the_game:
🔺 SPOILER ALERT: The narrative content of this DLC expands and enhances the story of our game. However, if you prefer to fully experience its twists and plot elements firsthand, we recommend reading it after completing the base game.

*This DLC consists of a PDF file installed in the game's directory at: DLC/PennyDreadful/.

Discover a new chapter in the dark universe of The Inheritance of Crimson Manor.

This PDF DLC plunges you into an official comic featuring original art in the Penny Dreadful style, inspired by the classic Victorian series of 1890 similar to those featured within the game.

Narrating the events that preceded the main experience, this visual tale offers a unique and complementary perspective on the story, unveiling secrets and details of the mansion’s past and helping to better understand what happened afterward.

Immerse yourself in a tale of gothic intrigue and mystery, and expand your understanding of the enigmatic legacy that envelops The Inheritance of Crimson Manor.
